spans.s: phaṇika, m. (= Skt. phaṇin), snake: Mv 〔ii.305.19〕; 〔iii.380.8〕 (both vs, in both v.l. phali˚).

phāṇī(-kṛta), (cf. Skt. phāṇita and Lex. phāṇi, f.), (mixed with) syrup or treacle: ˚kṛtaṃ mudgayūṣaṃ hareṇukayūṣaṃ … LV 〔264.16〕 (prose). Senart by em. puts phāṇikṛtam into Mv 〔ii.204.19〕, relying on the LV passage; but a comparison of the corrupt Mv mss. with Pali MN 〔i.245.19—20〕 seems to make it clear that Mv should be read: mudgakulattha-hareṇuka-kalāya-kṛta-yūṣam upabhuñje.
